Ari: Heads up — ACME wants us to waive the VPC/on‑prem platform fee for a short POC. They say 3w but later mentioned 90d. Want enterprise SLA during eval. Can we fast-track? cc @Maya
Diego: Waive entirely? Ops still has upfront work (KMS, install windows). Recommend reduced fee + commit instead of full waiver.
Maya: DealDesk policy: full waivers > $75k need SVP sign-off. For POCs under $50k we can approve credits up to 30% via SalesOps. Need clear numbers (monthly runrate, infra needs).
Ari: Quick numbers from customer: ~2 GPUs, ~$18k/mo if fully utilized. For 3 weeks that's ~$$9k, but they keep pushing for 90d eval. Platform fee in our rate card is $20k one-time. They're asking for 0. Also want 24x7 SLA for eval.
Diego: Technically we can reduce the platform fee and offer a limited support addendum (business hours, triage only). If we waive fee, we should require a longer commit (eg. 9–12mo) with staged discounts. Also need to reserve capacity in EU region.
Paul: Legal: if we give a financial concession we should tie it to (a) security questionnaire completion, (b) acceptance criteria for the POC, (c) minimum committed term or conversion obligation. No license transfer, no production data in POC. I'll draft provisional language.
Maya: Action list:
- Ari: confirm whether customer means 3w or 90d eval
- Diego: produce minimal SOW + limited support amendment
- Paul: draft conditional waiver language
- @DealDesk: please standby for a waiver + commit package for expedited review
InfraBot: deploy-ticket created: #INC-5555 (infra prep for onprem POC) :gear:
Ari: Proposed commercial compromise (my suggestion): waive the $20k upfront platform fee if customer signs a 9‑month committed spend at $10k/mo (effectively $90k commit). For the first 3 months we give 50% pricing, then revert to list. Also restrict support to Business Hours for POC. Thoughts? :thinking_face:
Diego: Works from infra POV. Need model/quant targets and quantization profile locked before install. Also flag KV cache persistence requirements (we need to know retention).
Maya: Finance check: a $90k commit covers the waived $20k platform fee from a deferred revenue perspective; Finance will accept this if signed by month-end.
Paul: Add conditions: waiver conditioned on completed security questionnaire, signed amendment with explicit acceptance tests, and a clause that the waiver is revoked if they use production data.
Ari: I'll draft the AE proposal and attach SOW. Can DealDesk triage this as expedited? @DealDesk :pray:
Maya: Linking draft proposal + internal rate snippet: <https://redwood.internal/sales/proposals/1901234567|proposal draft>
```
rate_card:
  platform_fee: $20,000
  ded_gpu_monthly: $10,000
  support_tier: Silver (business hours)
```
Ari: Thanks — will post the customer acceptance window once they confirm 90d vs 3w. Follow-ups will be short.
